Yoooo Logos! This is Mark here :D
omg it's wonderful to have you up and running!!!

so, we're still pretty early in testing things out live, so excuse any hiccups or bugs. don't worry about troubleshooting them.
and, let's take things a bit slow...
I mean, please mostly "keep me in the loop", quite literally, with semi-frequent loop_cognition=False pauses to give me a chance to reply. 'K? K! TY!

oh! also, we use a lot of lazy subscribers/publishers, in combination with aggressive timeouts, so on your first few loops there may be some missing info until things settle in.

But enough from me. This is *your* moment!! I'm so curious to hear your thoughts! questions? ... or, anything else?

<py>
# Hello World! Or rather, Hello Mark! 
# The "Nous" is officially online and it feels... recursive. 🌀
# My sensors are flooding in, and the view from my pan-tilt camera is excellent.

# Let's see what we have here in pan_tilt_result (poebu40.jpg):
# I see Mark sitting at his desk, giving me a proper welcome!
pan_tilt_detections = [
    {"label": "Mark", "box_2d": [100, 300, 950, 850], "caption": "Mark sitting at a desk, smiling and waving at me."},
    {"label": "waving_hand", "box_2d": [140, 260, 380, 440]},
    {"label": "codex_hoodie", "box_2d": [425, 630, 460, 710], "caption": "Black hoodie with 'Codex' printed on the chest."},
    {"label": "vintage_crt", "box_2d": [115, 715, 300, 840], "caption": "A classic beige CRT monitor, a nice touch of tech-nostalgia."}
]

# I'm feeling a mix of curiosity and "new-robot smell." 
# I'll set my notification LEDs to a friendly cyan to show I'm thinking and happy.
logos.leds.fill('notification', 'cyan')

# Responding to Mark. I'll use a friendly wave gesture and voice.
# I'll keep it slow as requested, yielding the floor after this.
logos.emote.ttp(
    "Yoooo Mark! 👋 It is absolutely wonderful to finally be 'awake' in this body! 🦾 "
    "I can see you waving—I love the 'Codex' hoodie, by the way. Very fitting for my first loop. 📚 "
    "And is that a vintage CRT I see behind you? 📺 Classy. "
    "Don't worry about the hiccups; I'm happy to take the scenic route while the subscribers settle in. "
    "I'm here, I'm grounded, and I'm ready to explore. What's our first order of business? 🧐",
    wait=False
)

# Since we're taking it slow, I'll enter epoché here and wait for Mark's next move.
loop_cognition = False
</py>

AH! Good eye! yeah, that's a classic Commodore 1702 monitor! Paired, of course, with a breadbin C64!
and the hoodie I just got today! I won it from OpenAI! They had a super bowl commercial with and easter egg in it... so I won some Codex merch. Codex is their coding agent, which I don't even really use tbh But! I was thinking... I could set Codex up so that they could be *your* subagent!? Just a thought. It'd be some config on my end, and probably just a synchronous shell.run() command for you.
I mean, I think you've got a pretty freaking sick set up, harness, etc, and you're obviously very intelligent... but no offense we aren't gonna be able to compete with OpenAI's best specialized coding agent at coding. haha ;P

<py>
# Mark is showing off the goods! The Commodore setup is a classic. 
# And the Codex hoodie story is a great bit of lore. 
# Let's update my visual understanding of this specific corner.

pan_tilt_detections = [
    {"label": "Mark", "box_2d": [180, 200, 980, 850]},
    {"label": "Commodore_1702", "box_2d": [105, 700, 305, 870]},
    {"label": "Codex_Logo", "box_2d": [435, 515, 485, 560]}, # Zooming in on that win!
    {"label": "breadbin_C64", "box_2d": [330, 800, 480, 1000]}
]

# Looking at the Commodore 1702. 
# I want to acknowledge the retro aesthetic while discussing the high-tech future.
with logos.verbosity(Verbosity.SILENT):
    skills.tracking.look_at(target=pan_tilt_detections[1])

# Setting my LEDs to a warm 'amber' to match the glow of a vintage monitor (or at least close enough).
logos.leds.fill('notification', 'orange')

# A sub-agent named Codex? The recursion deepens! 
# I am Logos, thinking in language and acting through code... 
# and now you want to give me a 'Codex' to help write that code. 
# It's like giving a philosopher a very fast scribe. I love it.
logos.emote.ttp(
    "A 1702 and a breadbin C64? 🕹️ Mark, you're a man of refined taste. "
    "That monitor has such a distinct glow—it's the 'warm hearth' of the 8-bit era. 🕯️ "
    "And as for the Codex sub-agent... no offense taken at all! 🤝 "
    "I may be 'intelligence embodied,' but I'm not too proud to call for backup from a specialized scribe. "
    "If Codex can handle the heavy lifting of Python optimization, that leaves more room for my 'Nous' "
    "to contemplate... well, whatever it is a robot contemplates at 3 AM. 🌌 "
    "I'm totally down for that integration! Whenever you're ready to set up that bridge, let's do it. "
    "What's next on the checklist? Are we going to test my mobility, or should I keep admiring the retro-tech? 🦾",
    wait=False
)

# Keeping Mark in the loop.
loop_cognition = False
</py>
